notes.title: The Spring Tournaments are here
notes.content:
[h1]Spring Tournament time![/h1]

Qualify in daily tournaments to get access to the weekend finals. Only the best players will be able to unlock the Cobble-Bot botparts!
Get them before they are gone!


[b]NewRanked Mode Rewards[/b]
Collect Ranked Points by performing well in tournaments or join the ranked mode in order to climb the ladder. If you reach gold by the end of the month you will get a super exclusive bot part. If you are number one, you will get: The crown!

tags.feature: - Added three new playable heroes: Queen of Pain, Slark, and Templar Assassin

tags.bug: - DE_Library: Fixed bug where some clients would crash on bomb explosion.

tags.balance_change: * Eul's Scepter of Divinity: Bonus movement speed reduced from +40 to +30

notes.title: Big update with new UI, Season and Map Randomizer
notes.content:
[b]UI Overhaul[/b]
We reworked the UI completely to work better with Controllers and feel more streamlined in general.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/754050/Bomb_Bots_Arena/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/754050/ss_d4fff29121c81ffe5047380c632c5f392d995507.1920x1080.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]New Season[/b]
The new season that will run for 1,5 months is full of magical warrior power and loooooove. This is the last season of it's kind. Stay tuned for more info on the next season.

[b]New Map Randomizer for Brawl, Rumble and Battle Royale Matches[/b]
The indestructible blocks appear now randomly on the map to change things up a bit. Rank-relevant modes stay the same though.

[b]Quick Play[/b]
You can hit Quick Play now, to join any open lobby.

[b]Sudden Death Delay[/b]
Since most matches between highly skilled players were mostly resolved by sudden death outplays, we wanted to test your real skills more. The sudden death will stop for a short while when the map size is limited until it will continue to burn everything in it's way.

[b]Ability Reset[/b]
You can now reset all your core spendings in the ability menu for 100 coins

[b]Unlock more Quest Slots[/b]
You can permanently unlock new quest slots for 200 coins

[b]Ability unlock and upgrade levels adjusted[/b]
You can know unlock all abilities until level 10 (if you have enough cores) so you are ready for tournaments earlier.

[b]New Level Cap 110[/b]
Grind you Bots, GRIND!!!

Plenty of bug fixes and improvements

notes.title: The Winter Season is here!
notes.content:
[h1]New Tournament Format[/h1]
You can now qualify for the Finals on weekends by participating in qualifier tournaments during weekdays:
If you outsmart the competetion in the qualifier tournament you will earn tournament tickets that are required to enter the finals AND unloick exclusive items in the shop.
The winners of the finals earn ranking points, coins and special bot parts that are only available for a limited time.
There are three daily tournaments now that cover several regions: EU, US and ASIA.

[h1]Sno-Bro and Talvi[/h1]
[list]
[*] [u]Sno-Bro[/u] is an urban myth: he is rumored to befriend lonely Bomb Kids.
Earn Season Points by doing quests and winning matches to unlock him.
[*][b]Talvi[/b] is the winter queen and a ruthless ruler. She was hidden away in layers of ice until these were shattered by the Battle Royale. Now she is back with vengance.
Talvi is only available for the best players in the tournament mode. Make sure to unlock all her parts before she end her reign at the end of winter and sleeps until the next one.
[/list]

[h1]New Ranked Season[/h1]
A new fight for the gold league has started! 

[h1]Level Cap 100[/h1]
You know what that means...

notes.title: Ranked Mode Beta is live!
notes.content:
[h1]Ranked Mode Beta[/h1]
Rakings have been reworked and you can compete for the top spots now on a regular basis in its own game mode: Ranked!
Rank inside the bronze, silver or gold league to unlock sweet prizes like coins, the exclusive UwU-Head and the Crown.

[h1]Minor Bug-Fixes[/h1]
We improved menu navigation and the battle royale camera.

notes.title: Battle Royale ist finally here!
notes.content:
[h1]Battle Royale[/h1]
[b]Battle Royale[/b] is now available for all players. 
The mode is still in the Alpha stage, that means that some things might still be rough around the edges, but we will constantly improve this new game mode.
Enter the Savage Lands, a completely new map that introduces two new Bomb Bots.

[h1]She-Ta and Wolfbang[/h1]
Two new Bomb Bots Skins to unlock in the Season and the shop. 
[list]
[*][b]She-Ta[/b] the queen of the savage lands will stop anyone from entering or leaving her domain at any cost. Her ferocity might be intimidating, but she is sworn to protect her "cubs" from the outside world at any cost.
[*]In the distant and savage lands where blazing fires rule over the harsh environment and ancient secrets are hidden deep in the green, there is one good boy trying to lead his Bots to a new save haven... [u]Wolfbang[/u]
[/list]

[h1]Level Cap 90[/h1]
As requested, here it is. Battle Royale allows you to earn even more XP per win!

notes.title: SP00KTOBER is haunting Bomb Bots Arena!
notes.content:
[h1]SP00KTOBER![/h1]
During the whole fifth season of BBA the Bomb Bots will use Bompkins instead of Bombs to celebrate the creepiest time of the year. The Sudden Death Area opens up the doors to the hollows so as always: Keep away!
Additionally we added many 2sp00ky unlockables to the game and make you go DOOT! DOOT! with the remix of our beloved main them.

[h1]NewLevel Cap 80[/h1]
More levels = More Coins and Cores. YAY!

[h1]Tournament Improvements[/h1]'
We want to thank everyone who provided us with feedback for the tournament during the beta. We implemented a lot of the requested changes and will provide the tournament with further weekly improvements so we can wrap up the beta this season.

notes.title: Season 4 introduces Tournaments (Beta)
notes.content:
[h2]Tournament Beta has started[/h2]
Tournaments are going to be one of the most important pillars of BBA. That's why we want your feedback as early during development as possible. 
The beta tournament will start on 01.09.20 at 7:30pm (CET) and will repeat on a daily basis. We chose this time as the most players are active during this period. Of course we will test different times and eventually have regional tournaments. This is just the beginning.
Make sure to share your thoughts on our [url=https://www.discord.gg/BombBotsArena]official discord[/url].

[h2]New Level Cap 70[/h2]
Even more Bomb Boxes (and therefore cores) to earn! You can now unlock all free Bot parts by just leveling up.

[h2]New Ability: Ghost[/h2]
Actually we already introduced it a week ago, but we wanted to test it first before making a big deal about it. So, here is the big deal: A new ability has entered the arena. You can now hide form other player's sight for a short amount of time.  [b]You can combine this ability with others.[/b] [i]Have you ever been punched by an invisible fist?[/i]

notes.title: SEASON 2 has arrived
notes.content:
[h1]Season 2 is live![/h1]

With this new update we introduce the following things:
[h2]New Level Cap 50[/h2]
More Bomb Boxes to earn! Yay!
[h2]Ability Upgrades[/h2] 
Availabe from level 40. Now you can finally spend those extra cores!
[h2]New ways to earn Season Points[/h2]
Winning a Match grants SP! Now you can grind for Season Points even if your quests are on cooldown.
You can also get the season boos from the shop. Get the double amount of Season Points from all sources.
[h2]Season Rank[/h2] 
Now you can compete to be the best player of the season. Maybe there is a special reward for this months #1...
[h2]Colors in the Shop[/h2]
Yes, black is finally here.
